titulo: Folha de sons 8b — os sons novos que você pediu
nota:
Só o que você pediu depois da folha 8: os flybys próprios das naves invasoras (os seus ficam com as naves do jogador), o metal rangendo no espaço, o asteroide que passa perto sem bater, o laser das mineradoras colossais e os martelos nas bigornas distantes.
O laser, os martelos e o metal entram como camadas sorteadas por cima do fundo da F2, sempre ao longe e pelo casco. Pode marcar mais de uma versão na nota para elas se alternarem.

sons.oque: AS NAVES INVASORAS — cada uma das 5 descendo das nuvens, com som próprio

versoes.nota: "a large alien warship descending through clouds far in the distance, a deep pulsing organic engine drone that swells as it approaches and fades away, heard from kilometers away, no music"
"a hostile dropship passing high overhead in the distance, a low menacing hum with a slow falling doppler pitch, muffled by the atmosphere, no music"
"an alien invader craft gliding down toward a city far away, a dark throbbing whine over a hollow rumble, rising then slowly falling in pitch, distant and muffled by the air, no music"

grupos.titulo: A F2: o cinturão e as mineradoras

sons.oque: O METAL RANGENDO NO ESPAÇO — as estruturas mortas ao longe, separado do fundo

versoes.nota: "a colossal derelict metal structure slowly twisting in deep space, a long low groan of stressed steel heard faintly through a ship hull, muffled and distant, no impact, no music"
"an enormous dead starship hull flexing far away, a deep resonant metallic moan with slow creaks, dull and distant, felt through the walls of a small ship, no music"

sons.oque: O ASTEROIDE PASSANDO PERTO — sem bater (o cascalho fica só para a batida)

versoes.nota: "a huge rock passing very close to a small spaceship in the vacuum, a low dull pressure rumble felt through the hull that swells and fades, no air whoosh, no impact, no music"
"a massive asteroid sliding past a cockpit, a deep soft sub bass swell with a faint hull vibration, muffled and heavy, no impact, no music"

sons.oque: O LASER DAS MINERADORAS — a vibração distante, abafada pelo espaço

versoes.nota: "a colossal mining laser cutting rock very far away in space, a low muffled vibration with a faint resonant electric hum felt through a ship hull, slowly swelling in and fading out, dark, no zaps, no music"
"an ancient giant orbital mining beam running in the distance, a deep droning throb with a thin muffled tone inside it, heard through thick metal in the vacuum of space, no zaps, no music"
"a distant industrial cutting beam heard only as a vibration through a spaceship hull, a slow wavering low buzz that comes and goes, very muffled, lonely deep space, no music"

sons.oque: OS MARTELOS NAS BIGORNAS — distantes, abafados pelo espaço

versoes.nota: "giant hammers striking anvils very far away, slow heavy metallic clanks muffled as if heard through the hull of a ship in space, dull with almost no ring, irregular rhythm, no music"
"a distant colossal forge in deep space, massive slow metal impacts, dull thuds with a faint muffled anvil ring, far away and contained, no music"
"three slow blows of an enormous hammer on a huge anvil kilometers away, each one a dull low clang felt through metal walls, muffled by the vacuum of space, long pauses between blows, no music"
